outcome: Pelvic dimensions (12 indicators including transverse diameter of the pelvic inlet, conjugate vera, diagonal conjugate, biischial diameter, anteroposterior diameter of the middle pelvis, transverse outlet, posterior sagittal diameter of outlet, conjugate of the outlet, anterior sagittal diameter of the outlet, curvature and length of the sacrum, angle of pubic arch)
finding: Women with gluteal muscle contracture tend to have anthropoid pelvises with significantly smaller biischial diameters compared to normal Chinese women, which may have implications for vaginal delivery.
